basics.name: Claiderman Alexander Lozano Cardona
basics.label: Backend Developer with experience in Microservices and Cloud
basics.summary: Backend Developer with more than 4 years of experience in software development. Has knowledge in Java, TypeScript, Python and cloud services (AWS, Azure). Has worked implementing REST APIs, managing databases and deploying solutions in the cloud. Had the opportunity to contribute to projects for clients such as Bancolombia, Banistmo and Grupo Familia, and currently works on developing backends for video games and interactive applications at Polygonus. Likes to continuously learn and adapt to new technologies.

work.name: Polygonus
work.summary: Develops backends for video game and interactive applications, implementing serverless architectures and cloud solutions. Works with clients such as Futureverse, Comfama and Fanta, developing scalable microservices and optimizing performance in high concurrency environments.
highlights: Designs and implements serverless architectures with TypeScript and AWS Lambda
Develops APIs with Python (Django/FastAPI) for educational platforms
Configures and optimizes NAKAMA servers for video games in AWS ECS/ECR
Implements CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments
Optimizes PostgreSQL databases and caching systems for high performance

work.name: Pragma
work.summary: Developed microservices and REST APIs for financial and retail sector clients, mainly using Java with Spring Framework. Actively participated in cloud solution architecture in AWS and Azure, implementing DevOps practices and agile methodologies (SCRUM/KANBAN).
highlights: Led the backend development for the Nosotras V-App mobile application, applying microservices architecture
Implemented auditing and logging systems for banking applications in Bancolombia
Redesigned the Pequeñin web platform, improving the backend architecture
Developed PDF sending system for credit management during the pandemic for Banistmo
Contributed to DevOps practice implementation with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD in Azure

work.name: Pragma
work.summary: Contributed as a full-stack developer on internal company projects, applying knowledge in Node.js, Java and Angular. Started experience with AWS implementing solutions with S3, DynamoDB and Cognito.
highlights: Developed full-stack components for internal company applications
Implemented frontend functionalities with Angular for management systems
Built backend services with Node.js and Java for enterprise applications
Implemented AWS S3 storage solutions and NoSQL databases
Collaborated in agile teams applying SCRUM methodologies

work.name: Emtelco S.A
work.summary: Provided specialized technical support for Internet, TV and fixed telephone services in Tigo-UNE. Developed problem-solving skills, customer service and technical incident analysis.
highlights: Complex technical issue resolution in telecommunications services
Improved customer satisfaction with effective solutions
Implemented cross-selling strategies during technical support
Used CRM systems for efficient ticket management and follow-up
Participated in specialized trainings in attention and technical support

work.name: Autodicol S.A.S
work.summary: Developed its first enterprise application: a Java with MySQL import management system that optimized department processes. Additionally, provided technical support to the company team.
highlights: Designed and implemented a Java desktop application for import management
Designed MySQL database for efficient data storage
Automated manual processes, reducing management times
Provided technical support to users and performed equipment maintenance
Implemented first complete enterprise software project

projects.name: Educational Platform
projects.description: Development of an educational platform for the Polygonus academy, implementing a system that supports multiple concurrent users with good response times.

projects.name: Panafutbol
projects.description: Developed a REST API for a football knockout game with a reward system. Implemented a bill redemption system that grants attempts in the game, a leaderboard for prizes, and real-time score synchronization. The API was designed to be consumed by a Unity WebGL3 client.

projects.name: Fanta Runner
projects.description: Developed a REST API for a runner-type game, designed specifically to be consumed by a Unity WebGL3 client. Implemented scoring systems, difficulty progression and real-time data synchronization with serverless backend.

projects.name: Dprimero Runner
projects.description: Developed a runner-type game with Nordic and cold environment where players must dodge barrels and fences. Implemented scoring systems, difficulty progression and real-time data synchronization with serverless backend.

projects.name: Agents of the Mundane
projects.description: Developed an educational game with gamification that integrates questions and answers to improve the learning experience. Implemented a serverless architecture that manages user progression and stores results for performance analysis.

projects.name: Game Server
projects.description: Implementation and configuration of NAKAMA server for video games, deployed in AWS ECS and ECR FARGATE. Implemented automatic scaling strategies to optimize resources.

projects.name: Futureverse Discord Bot
projects.description: Developed a Discord bot that integrates events from the TNL and Raicers games. Implemented a Factory and Event-Driven pattern that processes SQS messages and distributes them to different services based on event type, keeping the community informed about game updates and events in real time.

projects.name: The Next Legends (TNL)
projects.description: Developed the backend for an innovative AI-powered boxing game where players train virtual boxers. Implemented a serverless architecture that manages user profiles, real-time battles and character progression systems with NFTs.

projects.name: Raicers
projects.description: Contributed to the development of an AI-driven car racing game where players compete for rewards in scheduled races. Implemented matchmaking systems, rewards and digital asset management with cryptocurrencies.

projects.name: AI League FIFA
projects.description: Developed backends for an intelligent AI-powered football game in collaboration with FIFA, where players act as AI team coaches. Implemented authentication systems, user profiles and micropayments through Web3.

projects.name: Audit Log System
projects.description: Contributed to the software architecture for a centralized Audit Log system that processes daily events from various microservices in the Business area, improving search efficiency.

projects.name: Intelligent Search
projects.description: Developed a search system that improved user accessibility to Comfama services, reducing search times and facilitating navigation.

projects.name: Digital Credit Management
projects.description: Implemented a PDF sending system for credit management during the pandemic that processed multiple monthly requests, reducing response times.

projects.name: V-App Mobile Application
projects.description: Participated in the backend development for a mobile application, implementing a microservices architecture that improved system response.

projects.name: Transversal Architecture
projects.description: Contributed to a shared architecture for 5 brands of the Grupo Familia that facilitated the development of new features and improved maintenance efficiency.

projects.name: Web Platform
projects.description: Participated in the redesign of the Pequeñin web platform, implementing a backend architecture that improved load times and user experience.

projects.name: Import Management System
